content.comment_body: We have several modules with product number [article_no]. Is there PC-based software available to connect and program these modules? If not, are there any alternative options?

Yes, the current version of [product_name] software is compatible with these older modules. Your units are among the earliest models, over 25 years old. You will also need a programming cable—either the original RS232 cable with a USB/RS232 converter or a USB cable.

analysis.insight_summary: The user asks about compatibility of modern PC-based software with legacy [product_name] modules. The reply confirms that the latest software versions still support modules more than 25 years old, though users must use an appropriate programming cable. The exchange emphasizes strong product longevity and backward compatibility, with minor uncertainty about the required physical connections.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates a straightforward, up-to-date software solution from [company_name] that allows programming of older modules without complex workarounds.
